description: This Java class 'ServiceEcaUtil' manages the loading, caching, and evaluation of Service Event Condition Action (ECA) rules within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles configuration reloading, asynchronous rule loading from XML resources, and rule execution based on service events.

classes.name: ServiceEcaUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Service ECA rules, including loading, caching, and evaluating rules based on service events.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Clears the ECA cache and reloads configuration.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads ECA rules from configuration files and component resources asynchronously, populating the cache.

methods.name: addEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Adds ECA rules from a resource handler to the cache.

methods.name: getEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses ECA rules from an XML resource and returns a list of ServiceEcaRule objects.

methods.name: mergeEcaDefinitions
methods.description: Merges a list of ServiceEcaRules into the cache, replacing duplicates.

methods.name: getServiceEventMap
methods.description: Retrieves the event-to-rules map for a given service name.

methods.name: getServiceEventRules
methods.description: Retrieves rules for a specific service and event, or all rules if event is null.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates and executes rules for a given service event, with context and result maps.

methods.name: createEcaLoaderCallable
methods.description: Creates a Callable task to load ECA rules from a resource handler.
